C0386.title: Yueqing Employee Convicted for Absconding with Company Funds
C0386.summary: In late August 2025, the head of a Wenzhou trading company reported that an employee had misappropriated company funds using their position and then disappeared. Following intervention by the Yueqing People's Procuratorate, the employee was sentenced to imprisonment for embezzlement.
